basics.name: Snehar Koli
basics.headline: Technology Lead | Python Backend & Distributed Systems

summary: Technology Lead with 7+ years building production backend systems in Python. Leads cloud-native, event-driven platforms for financial-services workflows at Broadridge, with a track record of designing and shipping multiple scalable, mission-critical systems on AWS. Brings depth in resilient distributed architecture with Kafka, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB and Redis, and in engineering practices that keep delivery fast and safe: zero-downtime releases, automated testing and AI-assisted development.

bullets: Lead backend engineering for Broadridge's enterprise document-processing platform: Python (Flask, Django) services on AWS with REST and WebSocket APIs over PostgreSQL, DynamoDB and Redis
Architect durable, event-driven processing for high-volume workloads, with parallel execution, suspend/resume, idempotency and failure recovery
Designed an enterprise event-notification framework (transactional outbox, Kafka fan-out, secure webhooks) with idempotent delivery, replay and dead-letter handling
Drive the migration of the platform's core agents (splitter, classifier, extractor) from Google ADK on Amazon ECS to Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
Build and integrate MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers that give the platform's AI agents standardised, secure access to tools and enterprise data
Uphold engineering standards: zero-downtime releases, automated testing, and AI-assisted development and code review with GitHub Copilot and Claude
Set technical direction through trade-off analysis of scalability, accuracy, resilience and cost across OCR and GPT-vision approaches

experience.role: Senior Member of Technical Staff, AI Enablement
bullets: Architected and built IDP v2, a mission-critical serverless platform on AWS Lambda, Amazon SQS and Amazon Textract, processing 10,000+ documents/day within sub-5-minute SLAs
Re-architected the platform into containerised multi-agent services (Google ADK on Amazon ECS) behind an OpenAPI job-submission API
Built per-client LLM usage metering and billing on an on-behalf-of (OBO) architecture, attributing every model call to the originating client for accurate cost tracking and chargeback
Combined OCR, image recognition and generative-AI extraction on OpenAI GPT models, from GPT-4 through the latest generation, to cut manual effort by 80%+ and reduce turnaround from hours to minutes
Led full-stack development of a Shopify-integrated B2B SaaS returns platform (Python, Django, Angular) for global e-commerce merchants
Built the core merchant workflows (onboarding, catalog, order management and configurable returns and exchanges) that helped merchants reduce unnecessary returns
Integrated carrier APIs (UPS, DHL, XpressBees, Shiprocket) to automate shipping, labelling, tracking and reverse logistics
Reworked CI/CD and deployment processes, shortening release cycles by ~30%
Designed a microservices-based HR screening tool that automated resume parsing, candidate scoring and recruitment workflows
Built client web applications with Django, Angular, PHP and MySQL, including a MOOC platform with assessments and reporting
Designed and taught an advanced ML/NLP curriculum, mentoring learners through end-to-end projects
